ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْمَخْصُوْصِ بِالْإِسْرَاءِ وَالْمِعْرَاجِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Makhṣūṣi bi ‘l-Isrā’i wa ‘l-M`irāj.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the one selected for the Night Journey and Ascent!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَتَوِّجْنَا مِنَ الْقَبُوْلِ أَبْهَجَ تَاجٍ ،
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa tawwijnā min ‘l-qabūli abhaja tāj.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and crown us with acceptance with the most joyous crown,

ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْمَحْفُوْظِيْنَ مِنَ الْإِعْوِجَاجِ .
tr: Ṣallā Allāhu `alayhi wa `alā Ālihī, al-maḥfūẓīna min al-i`wijāj.
en: Allah's prayers upon him and his Family, who are safeguarded from deviations!
